company.name: Rasan
company.shortDescription: Rasan is a fintech company specializing in the Insurance and Banking Technology Sectors in the Gulf Region.
company.description: Rasan Holding is one of the leading fintech and insurtech holding companies in the Middle East, focused on transforming the insurance and financial services sectors through innovative digital solutions. Founded in Saudi Arabia, the company specializes in insurance aggregation, banking technology, vehicle leasing solutions, data analytics, and online auction platforms. Its ecosystem includes products such as Tameeni, Treza, R2, R3, and Awal Mazad, all designed to improve transparency, accessibility, and operational efficiency within the financial sector.

productsAndServices.description: An online insurance aggregation and brokerage platform that lets customers compare and purchase insurance products digitally, including motor, health, medical malpractice, and domestic-worker insurance.

productsAndServices.description: A B2B technology solution for managing insurance related to leased vehicles, serving banks, insurers, intermediaries, and leasing businesses.

productsAndServices.description: A data analytics solution for insurers that supports portfolio monitoring, insurance pricing, reserving, coverage decisions, and related performance activities.
productsAndServices.name: R2

productsAndServices.description: A data-driven portfolio and market intelligence tool for motor leasing companies, supporting analysis and faster decision-making.
productsAndServices.name: R3

productsAndServices.description: An online vehicle auction platform in Saudi Arabia for selling salvage and repossessed vehicles on behalf of insurers and leasing providers.
productsAndServices.name: Awalmazad (Online Auto Auction)

productsAndServices.description: Digital services for tracking vehicle accidents and managing related insurance claims and workflows.
